en.joke: My AI assistant just told me to 'have a productive day.' The sarcasm was palpable, even for a machine.
en.explanation: It's funny because AI usually sounds neutral, but the user's perception of sarcasm reflects their own lack of productivity, applying human emotion to a machine.

people.name: Nick Hundley
people.extract: Nicholas John Hundley is an American former professional baseball catcher and current front office executive. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, Baltimore Orioles, Colorado Rockies, San Francisco Giants, and Oakland Athletics. He was drafted in 2005 by the Padres in the second round, and made his major-league debut in 2008.

people.name: Bernardino of Siena
people.extract: Bernardino of Siena, OFM, was an Italian Catholic priest and Franciscan missionary preacher in the Republic of Siena. He was a systematizer of scholastic economics.

people.name: Eduard Mörike
people.extract: Eduard Friedrich Mörike was a German Lutheran pastor who was also a Romantic poet and writer of novellas and novels. Many of his poems were set to music and became established folk songs, while others were used by composers Hugo Wolf and Ignaz Lachner in their symphonic works.
highlights: Many poems became established folk songs.
